bns:Component.name: TransactionLog_SelectIdByCorrelation_V2_Request_JSON
bns:Component.bns:description: Database V2 request profile for Sub_Generate_CorrelationId's reread of the server-generated (NEWID()) transaction_id, keyed by correlation_id (which Boomi already knows). SQL Server has no INSERT...RETURNING, same reason as the prior MySQL design - but no Branch needed now, since Database V2's INSERT returns a real response document instead of zero documents. | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57
